listing.name: Sonic Advance 2 / SAT-R sa2 repository
listing.summary: Sonic Advance 2 SDL native build using your own supported ROM. Upstream documents separate Windows and Linux/macOS SDL outputs; its alternative Windows OpenGL target is documented as nonfunctional. Complete the title-specific SDL build before registering the prepared player.

steps.title: Prepare upstream or keep an existing game build
steps.instruction: Use your own supported Sonic Advance 2 ROM and upstream’s SDL build instructions. The documented Windows target is make sdl_win32, producing sa2.sdl_win32.exe; Linux/macOS use make sdl and sa2.sdl. The separate make win32 OpenGL target is documented as nonfunctional. These are Sonic Advance 2 outputs, not Sonic Advance 1. Keep the prepared working folder when registering your existing native player.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the game in a separate folder you control, and retain a working copy. Review its executable in Portcove, then add it without changing its files. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external copy. Follow the project’s instructions for the version you use when changing it.
